claims.claim: Canonical RESULT and FAILURE transport now emits or reuses one immutable operational attention ref only after the exact terminal artifact ref is published; notification failure remains subordinate and transport replay performs no execution or verification.

The GitHub-hosted workflow admits only exact attention-ref creation or bounded main-based manual replay, validates published-main lineage and canonical terminal binding, then creates or reuses one strict selector-only [AIOS TERMINAL ATTENTION] Issue.
Exact selector replay is idempotent, while competing terminal kinds, artifact SHAs, attention refs, malformed carrier Issues, or duplicate Issues fail closed without semantic or execution claims.

Existing transport and lifecycle surfaces remain compatible, documentation distinguishes terminal truth from attention delivery, all changes are within TASK-113 scope, and no unresolved implementation items remain.
